projectDescription: A research simulation framework for decentralized z-anonymity in smart metering networks, enabling privacy-preserving energy consumption data publication with minimal gateway coordination.
keyFeatures: Decentralized z-anonymity with ring-topology gateway coordination
Three simulation scenarios: deZent (decentralized w/ coordination), centralized, and fully decentralized without coordination
Counting Bloom Filter-based probabilistic data structure for privacy-preserving data aggregation
Simulated smart metering network with realistic Berlin/Treptow-Köpenick consumption profile distributions
Configurable simulation parameters: z value, number of gateways, max smart meters per gateway, random seed
Model validation against centralized Jha et al. z-anonymity baseline
Automated data analysis scripts for publication ratio, message count, and per-SM-type statistics
Full reproducibility of arXiv paper results via provided simulation data and scripts
publicApiSurface: main.py <n_gw> <n_max_sm> <z> <seed> — entry point for running all three simulation scenarios
zAnon.decent_zanon_w_comm(network, t_start_offset) — decentralized z-anonymization with GW ring coordination
zAnon.central_zanon_w_cnt_struct(network, t_start_offset) — centralized z-anonymization using counting structure
zAnon.fully_decent_zanon_wo_coord(network, t_start_offset) — fully decentralized z-anonymization without coordination
Network.init_network(dist_num_sms, max_n_sms_at_gw) — initialize virtual network with gateways and smart meters
Gateway.add_curr_measurement(cnt_struct, curr_time) — collect SM measurements and add to counting structure
Gateway.get_curr_records_for_publishing(cnt_struct, curr_time) — retrieve anonymized records eligible for publication
CBloomFilter(n, N, m, k) — counting Bloom filter for privacy-preserving data aggregation
zanon_utils.create_cnt_structure(n_sm_conn, anon_cycles, struct_type) — factory for counting data structures
zanon_utils.ensure_min_cnt_z(cnt_struct, z) — enforce z-anonymity threshold by subtracting constant from counts
zanon_utils.publish_anonyimzed_tuples(data_origin, cnt_struct, p_pub, curr_time) — publish z-anonymous tuples
analyze_simu_stats.analyze_cnt_data(...) — compute message count statistics across simulation scenarios
analyze_simu_stats.analyze_pub_ratio(...) — compute publication ratio statistics across simulation scenarios
jha_cent_zanon/zanon.py zanon.anonymize(tupla) — centralized Jha et al. z-anonymity baseline implementation
scripts/run_zanon_simu.sh — batch runner for all parameter combinations
